command: set -eu; adb start-server >/dev/null; adb devices -l; SERIALS=$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}'); COUNT=$(printf '%s\n' "$SERIALS" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l | tr -d ' '); test "$COUNT" = "1"; SERIAL=$(printf '%s\n' "$SERIALS" | head -n1); MODEL=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r'); test "$MODEL" = "SM-S906B"; echo MODEL=$MODEL; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell id; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.build.version.release; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.build.version.sdk; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.build.version.oneui
